text: Handling deadlines can feel stressful, but a few simple strategies make a big difference. Good time management starts with breaking a large project into smaller tasks and setting daily goals for each one. Prioritization is equally important—tackle the most difficult or urgent work first, rather than spending hours on easy tasks. You also need to practice scope management: know what is truly required and avoid adding extra features or details that were not requested. Finally, never underestimate communication. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early. A quick update can lead to adjusted expectations or extra help, which is far better than missing the deadline silently.
